scientific_integrity: Proof uses exhaustive integer chain and group-presentation computations with a self-contained source checker; independent mathematical validation not performed.
scientific_limitations: For the specific 4-by-5 toroidal hard-square independence complex under order-five horizontal translation: integral homology, three low homotopy groups and one multiplicative mod-five class are determined; neither all higher homotopy groups, the full cohomology ring nor a parameter-uniform theorem is asserted.
title: Integral homology and a nonzero mod-five cup product in a toroidal hard-square quotient
